name: Runner Tests Fixture - Emit Excluded Partial
brief: A suite where ONE object is EMIT-EXCLUDED. Its healthy sibling still runs (#3476); the dropped object's own test is reported SKIPPED and the bundle still fails.
description: Issue #2762. One object cannot bind, so BC's emit-retry loop excludes it. Program.cs used to empty this module's sources, so the healthy test codeunit next to it never ran either; since #3476 the dropped object is a test codeunit nothing else in the module names, so the survivor runs and the dropped object's own test is reported SKIPPED. Paired with a healthy sibling SUITE (same bundle) the bucket still reports Stage=Ran, which is the shape in which the loss used to be absent from every report surface.
